europe_now.title: US military aircraft relocated from UK base following security threat
europe_now.summary: United States military aircraft have been withdrawn from a second British military base due to an ongoing threat linked to Iran. The measure highlights heightened security concerns across European installations.

sources.headline: US military aircraft pulled from second UK base after ‘Iran threat’

europe_now.title: Malta blocks €13 billion European Union tobacco tax overhaul
europe_now.summary: Malta has vetoed a proposed European Union-wide overhaul of tobacco taxes valued at €13 billion, sparking frustration among member states. The decision halts legislative plans that required unanimous agreement within the bloc.

sources.headline: EU anger as Malta vetoes €13bn EU‑wide tobacco tax overhaul

top_stories.title: Trilateral Peace Negotiations on Ukraine Resume in Abu Dhabi
top_stories.summary: Representatives from Ukraine, Russia, and the United States have gathered in Abu Dhabi for new rounds of diplomatic discussions. The talks follow statements regarding the potential for a broader framework to secure peace.

sources.headline: Russia and Ukraine hold US-backed talks after Trump says broad deal is possible
US, Russia and Ukraine to restart talks in Abu Dhabi

top_stories.title: Investigation and Public Memorial Following Krakow Shooting
top_stories.summary: Thousands of individuals participated in a silent march in Poland to honor the victims of a recent mass shooting in Krakow. Meanwhile, authorities and fact-checkers are addressing significant online disinformation related to the incident.

sources.headline: Fact check: Online disinformation rife after Krakow mass shooting
